description: One row of GET /v1/sessions, and the whole body of GET /v1/registry/<session_id>, for a live Envoy session with no interest record, no role claim and no capability, as a real listener writes it; updated_at and last_seen come from the clock and are written here as 0. after_this_change is the row a listener built from the change writes, before_this_change the row one built from captured_at_commit writes. packages/envoy/cmd/listener/api_test.go builds the session entry from after_this_change and compares both routes' raw rows with it; packages/envoy-client/src/__tests__/transport.test.ts serves both rows to listSessions.
